tools.name: publish_temp
tools.title: Publish a new Temp
tools.description: Publish an inline text or base64 bundle to a stable public URL. Send index.html as the main page. Repeated identical calls are idempotent. If the MCP connection uses a temp.md account API key, the Temp is owned by that account immediately.

path.description: Safe relative bundle path. The main page should be index.html.

content.description: UTF-8 text by default, or base64 when encoding is base64.

tools.name: update_temp
tools.title: Update an existing Temp
tools.description: Atomically publish a new inline bundle behind the same canonical URL. The previous Version stays live if this call fails.

update_token.description: Scoped Temp update token. May be omitted when the MCP Authorization header contains an account API key that owns the Temp.

path.description: Safe relative bundle path. The main page should be index.html.

content.description: UTF-8 text by default, or base64 when encoding is base64.

tools.name: get_temp_status
tools.title: Get Temp status
tools.description: Inspect lifecycle, expiry, restore eligibility, ownership, moderation, and settings.

update_token.description: Scoped Temp update token. May be omitted when the MCP Authorization header contains an account API key that owns the Temp.

tools.name: restore_temp
tools.title: Restore an expired Temp
tools.description: Reactivate an expired Temp during its restore grace period without changing its URL.

update_token.description: Scoped Temp update token. May be omitted when the MCP Authorization header contains an account API key that owns the Temp.

tools.name: snapshot_temp
tools.title: Freeze a snapshot
tools.description: Create a fixed snapshot URL for the current Version while the canonical URL continues to track the latest Version.

update_token.description: Scoped Temp update token. May be omitted when the MCP Authorization header contains an account API key that owns the Temp.

tools.name: set_comments
tools.title: Enable or disable comments
tools.description: Toggle pinned visitor feedback on a Temp.

update_token.description: Scoped Temp update token. May be omitted when the MCP Authorization header contains an account API key that owns the Temp.

tools.name: list_temps
tools.title: List account Temps
tools.description: List Temps owned by the account API key supplied in the MCP Authorization header.

tools.name: recover_update_token
tools.title: Recover a Temp update token
tools.description: Rotate every prior scoped update token and return one replacement. Requires an owning account API key in the MCP Authorization header.
